cues.en: Let's implement the functionality to allow a customer to download a PDF copy of the transactions using a celery task.
cues.zh: 使用 Celery 工作，實作讓客戶下載交易 PDF 副本的功能。

cues.en: This approach will handle the PDF generation asynchronously, improving the responsiveness of our API.
cues.zh: 以非同步方式產生 PDF，提升 API 的回應速度。

cues.en: And so back in the terminal, let's first install the package which I'll use to generate PDFs.
cues.zh: 回到終端機，先安裝用來產生 PDF 的套件。

cues.en: And it's called Reportlab.
Reportlab is an open source Python library for generating PDFs.
cues.zh: ReportLab 是產生 PDF 的開源 Python 函式庫。

cues.en: So first make sure that your virtual environment is activated.
cues.zh: 先確認虛擬環境已啟用。

cues.en: As you can see mine is activated.
Then we're going to say pip install Reportlab version 4.2.2.
cues.zh: 執行 pip install，安裝 ReportLab 4.2.2。

cues.en: Good.
Once the package has been installed, let's confirm from our Project Explorer.
cues.zh: 安裝完成後，從專案檔案總管確認。

cues.en: So going to go to the Pip file.
Then we're going to see somewhere down here we have Reportlab right there.
cues.zh: 下面這裡可以看到 reportlab。

cues.en: Perfect.
Then let's add this package to our requirements.txt file.
So you're going to go back to the terminal.
Then you're going to say pip freeze, then backend requirements.txt like that.
cues.zh: 執行 pip freeze，輸出至 backend/requirements.txt。

cues.en: Perfect.
Then go back to the requirements.txt file within backend.
cues.zh: 回到 backend 裡的 requirements.txt。

cues.en: Then confirm that you now have reportlab which is going to be somewhere here.
cues.zh: 確認裡面有 reportlab，應該在這附近。

Perfect.

cues.zh: 新增套件後，必須重新建置容器。

cues.en: Always remember that packages are installed in containers at build time and not runtime.
cues.zh: 記得套件是在容器建置時安裝，而非執行時。

cues.en: So let's go back to the terminal.
Then we can now say make build.
Good.
Once we've rebuilt our containers, let's go to the Project Explorer.
